purpose: Core regressions that must remain true while TOV evolves.
purposeKo: TOV 개발 중 반드시 유지되어야 하는 핵심 회귀 시나리오입니다.

scenarios.titleKo: 물 점유 관측 추가와 제거
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 물 영역에 들어간 오브젝트는 occupies 관계가 관측된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 물 영역에서 벗어나면 occupies 관계가 제거된다.

scenarios.titleKo: 런타임 관측 Fact 소유권
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 센서가 직접 발행한 관측 Fact만 회수한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 같은 트리플이 이미 작성되어 있으면 센서가 소유권을 주장하거나 제거하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Only durable fact origins enter a local snapshot
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Durable authored and persistent state facts survive save and restore.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Runtime observations, inferred facts, account projections, and appearance projections are omitted.

scenarios.title: Removing action data removes the matching behavior
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Only explicitly supplied action definitions can create candidates and effects.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: An empty catalog or unmatched verb cannot synthesize an arbitrary Fact.

scenarios.titleKo: 부력 추론의 활성화와 제거
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Floating 추론 상태가 있으면 부력 어댑터가 활성화된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Floating 상태를 제거하면 부력 어댑터가 비활성화된다.

scenarios.titleKo: 팩트 기반 착용과 해제
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Near 및 equipped 관계가 성립하면 장착 표현이 적용된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 장착 관계가 없어지면 월드 오브젝트 상태로 돌아간다.

scenarios.titleKo: Tab 근처 오브젝트 선택 순환
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 가까운 오브젝트가 거리순으로 순환 선택된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 비활성/삭제된 오브젝트는 순환 후보에서 제외된다.

scenarios.titleKo: 물리 의미 선택의 온톨로지 동기화
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 물리 의미를 선택하면 필요한 관계/규칙 연결이 함께 설정된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 다른 물리 의미로 바꾸면 이전 의미의 종속 데이터가 남지 않는다.

scenarios.titleKo: 계정-캐릭터-월드 입장
scenarios.evidenceTest: Manual Unity smoke: connect, select saved character, register avatar, enter world
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 인증된 계정이 저장 캐릭터와 월드를 읽고 아바타를 등록한 뒤 입장한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 안정 아바타 ID 또는 등록이 없으면 입장이 거부되고 월드 Fact가 임의로 생성되지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Authority atomically applies and removes a complete meaning package
scenarios.titleKo: Authority가 완전한 의미 패키지를 원자적으로 적용·제거
scenarios.evidenceTest: Apply arbitrary-object package, remove package, independently remove one owned Rule Block, complete package cleanup at the final Rule Block, preserve typed Fact ownership, adopt a pre-existing unclaimed catalog baseline, migrate an older immutable Rule Block version; BaselinePackageCanRequestUnclaimedContributionAdoption; RemovingPreconfiguredRulesCompletesOwnedBaselineOnlyAtLastRule; MeaningPackagePreservesTypedAuthoredFacts; Unity late-scene binding: AuthorityBridgeSubscribesWhenWorldEditorAppearsAfterBridgeEnable
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An arbitrary placed object or catalog-preconfigured entity receives one Authority-owned package containing its authored Triple, published Rule Block, and physical profile; an exact pre-existing unclaimed contribution can be adopted without a name exception, and an older unclaimed definition version is atomically replaced by exactly one active requested version with a fresh binding identity.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing one owned Rule Block retracts only that binding and its RuleBound results; removing the final owned Rule Block retracts the package-owned canonical and typed Triples and restores only displaced authored baseline values, while independent or differently owned data survives.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 임의 배치 오브젝트가 작성 트리플·게시 룰블록·물리 프로필을 하나의 월드 리비전에서 함께 받는다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 패키지 또는 소유 룰블록을 제거하면 전체 기여분이 철회되고 밀려난 작성 기준값이 복원된다.

scenarios.title: Player-facing behavior authoring uses one complete Quick Setup path
scenarios.titleKo: 사용자 행동 저작은 하나의 완전한 빠른 설정 경로를 사용
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Quick Setup reads a data-defined preset and applies the complete Triple, Rule Block, and optional Physical Meaning package.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: The player-facing Rule Block page exposes no bind-only add or edit path; assigned blocks can only be inspected or removed.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 빠른 설정이 데이터 프리셋을 읽어 트리플·규칙 블록·선택적 물리 의미 전체 패키지를 적용한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 사용자용 규칙 블록 화면에는 규칙만 추가하거나 교체하는 경로가 없고, 연결된 블록은 확인하거나 제거만 할 수 있다.

scenarios.title: Remote avatar presentation excludes the stable local actor
scenarios.titleKo: 원격 아바타 표현에서 안정 로컬 Actor 제외
scenarios.enabledExpectation: The account or local-input actor is excluded from remote replication even when an arbitrary world identity was discovered first.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Without a stable account/input actor, no arbitrary carryable, NPC, monster, or placed entity is guessed to be the local avatar.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 임의 월드 식별자가 먼저 발견돼도 계정 또는 로컬 입력 Actor는 원격 복제에서 제외된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 안정적인 계정·입력 Actor가 없을 때 Carryable·NPC·몬스터·배치 엔티티를 로컬 아바타로 추측하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Remote avatars render an ordered Authority motion timeline
scenarios.titleKo: 원격 아바타는 순서가 보장된 Authority 이동 타임라인을 표시한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Fixed-tick Authority motion changes are batched into session/tick ordered SignalR frames and Unity renders a delayed interpolation timeline with only short velocity-bounded extrapolation.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A stale generation, reordered tick, old runtime session, long transport gap, or missing direct frame cannot rewind an avatar, chase a destination at a Unity-owned speed, or remove presence from a delta omission.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 고정 Tick Authority 이동 변경분은 세션과 Tick 순서가 있는 SignalR 프레임으로 묶이며 Unity는 지연 보간과 짧은 속도 제한 외삽만 사용해 표시한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 오래된 연결 세대, 역순 Tick, 이전 런타임 세션, 긴 전송 공백, 직접 프레임 누락은 아바타를 되감거나 Unity 임의 속도로 목적지를 추격하거나 변경분 누락만으로 존재를 제거할 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Realtime migration starts with measurable Authority and presentation evidence
scenarios.titleKo: 실시간 전송 이관은 측정 가능한 Authority 및 표현 증거부터 시작한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Authority fixed-tick and SignalR motion publication emit low-cardinality duration, overrun, item, and failure evidence while Unity records session-local transport and interpolation health.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing diagnostic listeners changes no Rule, Fact, runtime session, motion state, or presentation result; UDP remains disabled until its security and loss gates pass.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Authority 고정 Tick과 SignalR 이동 발행은 낮은 카디널리티의 시간·초과·항목·실패 증거를 만들고 Unity는 현재 세션의 전송·보간 상태를 기록한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 진단 listener를 제거해도 Rule, Fact, 런타임 세션, 이동 상태와 표현 결과는 변하지 않으며 보안·손실 검증 전까지 UDP는 비활성이다.

scenarios.title: Unity and Authority use one pinned UDP transport substrate
scenarios.titleKo: Unity와 Authority가 동일한 고정 UDP 전송 기반을 사용한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Unity OpenUPM and Authority NuGet resolve the exact LiteNetLib 2.1.4 version while HTTPS and SignalR retain control and recovery ownership.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A missing, floating, mismatched, or differently sourced transport dependency fails development verification before the UDP lane can be enabled.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Unity OpenUPM과 Authority NuGet이 정확히 LiteNetLib 2.1.4를 사용하며 제어와 복구 소유권은 HTTPS와 SignalR에 남는다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 의존성이 없거나 버전이 유동적·불일치·다른 출처이면 UDP 활성화 전에 개발 검증이 실패한다.

scenarios.title: UDP transport admission is one-time and Authority session bound
scenarios.titleKo: UDP 전송 입장은 일회성이며 Authority 세션에 결합된다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Authenticated HTTPS issues a server-generation-bound ticket and Redis atomically revalidates and promotes exactly one proof-bearing transport session.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Disabled feature, stale runtime, invalid proof, replay, expiry, deactivation, missing Redis protection, or untrusted HTTP cannot create an authenticated UDP session.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 인증된 HTTPS가 서버 generation 결합 ticket을 발급하고 Redis가 증명된 전송 세션 하나만 원자적으로 재검증·승격한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 기능 비활성, 오래된 런타임, 잘못된 증명, 재전송, 만료, 비활성화, Redis 보호 누락, 신뢰하지 않은 HTTP는 인증 UDP 세션을 만들 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Authority UDP listener authenticates and fences motion intents before gameplay
scenarios.titleKo: Authority UDP 리스너가 게임 실행 전에 이동 의도를 인증하고 차단 경계를 적용한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A fixed bootstrap, one-time ticket proof, current generation, packet MAC, replay window, delivery channel, and payload binding are all validated before an intent reaches the isolated bounded sink.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Disabled listener, malformed bootstrap, invalid proof, stale generation, replay, wrong delivery method/channel, overload, shutdown, or missing current session cannot invoke gameplay or mutate durable state.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 고정 부트스트랩, 일회용 티켓 증명, 현재 세대, 패킷 MAC, 재전송 창, 전송 채널, 페이로드 결합을 모두 검증한 뒤에만 의도가 격리된 제한 큐에 도달한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 리스너 비활성, 잘못된 부트스트랩·증명, 오래된 세대, 재전송, 잘못된 전송 방식·채널, 과부하, 종료, 현재 세션 누락은 게임 동작이나 영속 상태를 변경할 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Unity prepares authenticated UDP motion without creating a second active writer
scenarios.titleKo: Unity가 두 번째 활성 Writer 없이 인증 UDP 이동 전송을 준비한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An explicitly enabled, exact active runtime binding may obtain an HTTPS ticket and prepare a server-compatible authenticated Unreliable channel 0 datagram while HTTP remains the sole active gameplay writer.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Default-off, disable, session/world/avatar/zone change, stale admission response, invalid credential, timeout, or disconnect clears the transport secret and cannot send or replace the HTTP writer.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 명시적으로 활성화되고 정확한 활성 런타임에 결합된 경우에만 HTTPS 티켓으로 서버 호환 인증 Unreliable 채널 0 데이터그램을 준비하며, 실제 게임 Writer는 HTTP 하나로 유지한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 기본 비활성, 비활성화, 세션·월드·아바타·Zone 변경, 오래된 입장 응답, 잘못된 자격 증명, 시간 초과, 연결 해제는 전송 비밀값을 지우며 송신하거나 HTTP Writer를 대체할 수 없다.

scenarios.title: HTTP and UDP motion share one Rule-evaluated Authority admission
scenarios.titleKo: HTTP와 UDP 이동이 하나의 Rule 평가 Authority 입장을 공유한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Authenticated UDP and HTTP candidates pass the same ownership, runtime session, complete locomotion contract, Rule preview, revision and atomic single-writer admission before the fixed-tick registry accepts one canonical intent.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Missing or removed Rule Block, stale session/generation/revision, pending commit, duplicate sequence, inactive writer, invalid semantics, transient cache pressure, or durable mutation fails closed without publishing an intent.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 인증 UDP와 HTTP 후보는 같은 소유권, 런타임 세션, 완전한 이동 계약, Rule 미리보기, revision, 원자적 단일 Writer 입장을 통과한 뒤에만 고정 Tick 레지스트리에 하나의 canonical intent를 등록한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Rule Block 누락·제거, 오래된 세션·세대·revision, 커밋 대기, 중복 sequence, 비활성 Writer, 잘못된 의미, 일시적 캐시 압력, 영속 mutation은 intent를 등록하지 않고 실패 폐쇄된다.

scenarios.title: Authority publishes bounded authenticated UDP Zone motion snapshots
scenarios.titleKo: Authority가 제한되고 인증된 UDP Zone 이동 스냅샷을 발행한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An Authority fixed-tick Zone frame is paged under the transport MTU, routed through the multi-instance backplane, generation-fenced in one bounded batch, and authenticated per active peer without changing canonical gameplay state.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Disabled UDP, stale generation, missing peer, malformed or oversized input, stale Zone tick, backplane failure, or generation timeout emits no UDP snapshot and cannot stop Authority simulation or SignalR fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Authority 고정 Tick Zone 프레임은 전송 MTU 아래로 분할되고 다중 인스턴스 backplane을 거쳐 제한된 일괄 세대 검증 후 활성 peer별로 인증되며 canonical 게임 상태를 변경하지 않는다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: UDP 비활성, 오래된 세대, peer 없음, 잘못되거나 너무 큰 입력, 이전 Zone Tick, backplane 장애, 세대 조회 시간 초과는 UDP 스냅샷을 만들지 않으며 Authority 시뮬레이션이나 SignalR 대체 경로를 중단시킬 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Unity accepts only complete authenticated UDP motion occurrences through the shared feed
scenarios.titleKo: Unity가 완전히 인증된 UDP 이동 occurrence만 공용 feed로 수신한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An exact active transport binding may assemble reordered authenticated protocol-v2 pages and publish one occurrence through the motion feed after SignalR or HTTP confirms each actor runtime session.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Default-off receive, invalid HMAC/session/generation/world/Zone, replay, incomplete or inconsistent pages, stale recovery, unknown actor session, disable, or scope change publishes no UDP presentation and never enables the UDP input writer.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 정확한 활성 전송 결합은 인증된 프로토콜 v2 페이지를 역순에서도 완전히 조립하고 SignalR 또는 HTTP가 actor 런타임 세션을 확인한 뒤 하나의 occurrence만 이동 feed로 발행한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 기본 비활성 수신, 잘못된 HMAC·세션·세대·월드·Zone, replay, 불완전하거나 불일치한 페이지, 오래된 복구, 확인되지 않은 actor 세션, 비활성화, scope 변경은 UDP 표현을 발행하지 않으며 UDP 입력 Writer를 켜지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Unity UDP transport faults cross injectable production boundaries
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Ticket admission, driver connection, authenticated send, ordered acknowledgement, fallback recovery, and fresh-ticket reconnect use the same injected boundaries as the production transport.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Outbound failure, acknowledgement timeout, network failure, lost fallback response, or expired ticket fences UDP and cannot bypass reliable Authority recovery.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Ticket 발급, 드라이버 연결, 인증 송신, 순서 ACK, fallback 복구 및 새 Ticket 재연결이 production 전송과 같은 주입 경계를 사용한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 송신 차단, ACK 시간초과, 네트워크 오류, fallback 응답 유실 또는 만료 Ticket은 UDP를 차단하며 신뢰성 있는 Authority 복구를 우회하지 못한다.

scenarios.title: Account profile relations are revisioned and idempotent
scenarios.titleKo: 계정 프로필 관계의 리비전 및 멱등 저장
scenarios.evidenceTest: Manual authority smoke: PUT profile relation, replay identical command, then remove relation
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A profile relation is stored once for the owned character and the returned profile revision advances.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Replaying the same command does not duplicate a relation; a later revision with an empty relation set removes it.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 소유 캐릭터의 프로필 관계는 한 번만 저장되고 프로필 리비전이 증가한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 같은 명령을 재시도해도 관계가 중복되지 않으며, 이후 빈 관계 집합을 저장하면 관계가 제거된다.

scenarios.title: Account profile relations project to and retract from the local avatar runtime view
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A portable Self relation becomes a fact on the selected local avatar at runtime.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Clearing the projection retracts only the profile-projected fact.

scenarios.title: NPCs use the same actor-scoped action candidate pipeline
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An NPC can receive and execute a data-defined help candidate.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Without the candidate conditions the NPC does not receive that action.

scenarios.title: World avatar profile overlays are revisioned world commands
scenarios.evidenceTest: Manual authority smoke: set_avatar_profile_relations accepts owner avatar only and advances one world revision
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A world-specific role or progression relation is stored against the registered avatar.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A different user cannot modify the avatar profile and an empty relation set removes the overlay.

scenarios.title: Worlds execute only enabled immutable package actions
scenarios.evidenceTest: Manual authority smoke: publish action_effect, enable package, execute_action with registered avatar, then retry disabled package
scenarios.enabledExpectation: The Authority resolves the enabled immutable definition and records its action Fact under one revisioned command.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A disabled/mismatched package, arbitrary predicate, or unregistered actor cannot create an action Fact.

scenarios.title: A registered account reaches an Authority action without a trusted client identity header
scenarios.evidenceTest: Authority smoke: register, use Bearer session, create character/world, reject missing or revoked session, login again, enter and reload projection
scenarios.enabledExpectation: The account creates/selects a character, the Authority places/registers its stable avatar, and an enabled package action advances the world revision.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: If avatar placement, package activation, or action validation fails, the client reports rejection and does not write a local durable substitute.

scenarios.title: World authoring is gated by the selected world's role
scenarios.evidenceTest: Manual authority smoke: owner/editor can publish; viewer receives forbidden and no duplicate replay event
scenarios.enabledExpectation: owner/editor sessions expose CanEditCurrentWorld and accepted commands advance one revision
scenarios.disabledExpectation: viewer sessions do not auto-publish and server rejects a command with forbidden

scenarios.title: World runtime is exposed only after confirmed entry
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A completed Authority entry transition enables the gameplay runtime.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Signed-out, selected, entering, failed, and recovering states do not expose gameplay.

scenarios.title: Pre-entry presentation hides player and world UI
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Account UI remains usable before entry.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Player renderers, HUD, quest toggles, runtime editors, and gameplay input remain inactive.

scenarios.title: Local snapshots are isolated by account and world
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Each account/world pair resolves to its own atomic local snapshot path.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A snapshot from another account or world cannot be loaded through the current scope.

scenarios.title: Avatar resume is a revisioned Authority checkpoint
scenarios.evidenceTest: Executable smoke: register, enter, save_avatar_checkpoint, logout, login, then load the same checkpoint
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An owned avatar checkpoint advances one world revision and restores its zone and transform.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Per-frame motion does not create checkpoint events and an unowned avatar cannot be updated.

scenarios.title: Only transport-failed commands enter the scoped outbox
scenarios.evidenceTest: Code contract: retain original command ID for account/world-scoped replay and omit credentials
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A transport failure is replayed idempotently after the matching world entry.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Accepted, terminally rejected, differently scoped, or credential data is not retained.

scenarios.title: Creator specialist NPCs are an owner-only presentation layer
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An entered owner session with creator mode enabled can see the specialist workspace.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Signed-out, pre-entry, creator-mode-off, editor, and viewer sessions cannot see the workspace or receive hidden world Facts.

scenarios.title: Bootstrap composes separate world and UI scenes without bypassing entry gates
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Bootstrap loads World and UI additively, preserves authored ontology facts, and binds services to the separated presentation scenes.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Before confirmed world entry, world HUD remains hidden and the composition contains no duplicate EventSystem, AudioListener, or legacy Farm UI canvas.

scenarios.title: TOV is the player-facing brand while technical identifiers remain stable
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Unity builds use TOV, Smileon Labs, and com.smileonlabs.tov.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: The branding change does not rewrite Tormia namespaces, scene paths, Docker resources, storage prefixes, or ontology IDs.

scenarios.title: Runtime adapters retract only their own contribution

scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing that observation cannot delete an equal durable contribution.

scenarios.title: Editable display names never become implicit ontology IDs
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An explicitly configured entity ID survives a GameObject rename.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: An unconfigured OntologyObject has no ID and is not bound by its GameObject name.

scenarios.title: The World Architect starts with a non-durable prompt draft
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A valid prompt creates an ordered service route from the creator catalog.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Short prompts or a missing WorldArchitect are rejected and no world Fact is created.

scenarios.title: Placed-object durable facts use stable entity identity
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Placed-record concepts, facts, and rule blocks project under the stable entity ID.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Renaming the editable instance does not create or retain a display-name Fact subject.

scenarios.title: Creator production routes require unique canonical services
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A valid catalog produces one deterministic ordered service route.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Duplicate canonical service IDs are rejected instead of silently being collapsed.

scenarios.title: Avatar checkpoint retry is limited to revision conflicts
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A stale revision reloads the Authority projection before one fresh command.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Permission, validation, and transport failures do not trigger a hidden second command.

scenarios.title: Authority-owned equipment and bounded combat transitions
scenarios.titleKo: Authority 소유 장착 및 경계형 전투 전이
scenarios.evidenceTest: Disposable-stack smoke: atomic typed placement, missing damage rejection, data-owned damage, attack three times, replay final command, disable package, login again
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An enabled immutable action reads attack_damage from the equipped tool, reduces bounded health, and records death and loot availability while preserving target-authored loot.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing attack_damage or hostility removes attack behavior; replay, defeated targets, and disabled packages cannot apply damage.

scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: attack_damage 또는 적대성을 제거하면 공격 동작도 사라지며 재전송·사망 대상·비활성 패키지는 피해를 적용하지 못한다.

scenarios.title: Authority placement atomically preserves typed template facts
scenarios.titleKo: Authority 배치의 타입 보존 초기 트리플 원자 처리
scenarios.enabledExpectation: One place_entity command carries the entity transform, concepts, numeric health, boolean life state, and content relations.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Without Authority readiness no durable local substitute is created, and malformed typed facts reject the whole placement.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 하나의 place_entity 명령이 엔티티 Transform·개념·수치 체력·불리언 생존 상태·콘텐츠 관계를 함께 전달한다.

scenarios.title: Accepted action metadata selects actor animation intent

scenarios.enabledExpectation: The exact accepted package/action/definition version resolves its canonical actor animation intent through the actor repertoire.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Rejected, replayed, mismatched, or presentation-free actions cannot invent an animation.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 정확히 승인된 패키지·행동·정의 버전이 배우 레퍼토리를 통해 canonical 애니메이션 의도를 해석한다.

scenarios.title: Authority owns proximity, exclusive equipment, and unequip
scenarios.titleKo: Authority 소유 거리·독점 장착·해제

scenarios.disabledExpectation: A distant or occupied weapon is rejected and unequip removes both relations without a Unity fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 가까운 미점유 무기는 정방향·역방향 장착 관계를 원자적으로 생성한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 멀거나 점유된 무기는 거부되고 해제는 Unity fallback 없이 두 관계를 제거한다.

scenarios.title: Animation manifest generates runtime definitions and actor repertoires
scenarios.titleKo: 애니메이션 매니페스트 기반 런타임 정의와 배우 레퍼토리 생성
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A compatible canonical manifest entry becomes a runtime animation definition available to an explicitly assigned actor profile.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing the manifest entry removes the generated definition and profile membership without a hidden fallback or stale-database resurrection.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 호환되는 canonical 매니페스트 항목이 명시적으로 지정된 배우 프로필에서 사용할 수 있는 런타임 애니메이션 정의가 된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 매니페스트 항목을 제거하면 숨은 fallback이나 오래된 데이터베이스 복원 없이 생성 정의와 프로필 소속도 제거된다.

scenarios.title: Base animation state is resolved from ephemeral observations
scenarios.titleKo: 일시 관찰 기반 기본 애니메이션 상태 해석
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Movement, airborne/fall, landing, and equipped locomotion select canonical intents locally.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: No per-frame animation state is persisted as a world Fact or used as an Authority gameplay capability.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 이동·공중·낙하·착지·장착 이동이 로컬에서 canonical 의도를 선택한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 프레임별 애니메이션 상태를 월드 Fact로 저장하거나 Authority 게임플레이 capability로 사용하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: World entry confirms the exact published animation intent projection

scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 다시 읽은 투영의 패키지 ID·패키지 버전·행동 정의 버전·canonical 애니메이션 의도가 모두 일치한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 의도가 없거나 일치하지 않으면 개발 패키지 검증에 실패하며 경고만 남기고 입장하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: UGC animation files require quarantine, metadata, validation, and approval
scenarios.titleKo: UGC 애니메이션 격리·메타데이터·검증·승인
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A licensed FBX can be staged, validated, explicitly approved, and then synchronized into the manifest.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Unlicensed, invalid, oversized, non-FBX, or unapproved files never enter the approved runtime manifest.
