scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 라이선스 누락·검증 실패·용량 초과·FBX 아님·미승인 파일은 승인 런타임 매니페스트에 들어가지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Player motion resets per session and stays within the authored speed cap
scenarios.titleKo: 플레이어 이동의 세션 초기화와 작성 속도 상한 수렴
scenarios.enabledExpectation: World entry clears the prior transient sequence, then the fixed-tick Authority scheduler normalizes direction and clamps requested walk/run speed to authored movement_speed.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Offline avatars stop refreshing motion TTL, and removing movement_speed disables server movement instead of restoring a hidden fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 월드 입장은 이전 일시 입력 시퀀스를 지우고, 이후 Authority 고정 Tick 스케줄러가 방향을 정규화하고 걷기·달리기 요청 속도를 작성된 movement_speed 이내로 제한합니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 오프라인 아바타는 이동 TTL 갱신을 멈추며 movement_speed를 제거하면 숨은 fallback 없이 서버 이동이 비활성화됩니다.

scenarios.title: World Authority builds collision proxies only from authored ontology data
scenarios.titleKo: World Authority는 작성된 온톨로지 데이터로만 충돌 프록시를 만든다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Explicit collision_role, collision_proxy_shape, dimensions, center offsets, and a durable entity transform build a bounded Capsule or Box server proxy without reading a prefab, mesh, object name, or Unity Collider.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing a required dimension, using an unsupported role or shape, or supplying invalid bounds rejects proxy construction; no visual or component fallback restores it.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 명시적 collision_role·collision_proxy_shape·치수·중심 오프셋과 영속 엔티티 Transform이 Prefab·Mesh·오브젝트 이름·Unity Collider를 읽지 않고 제한된 Capsule 또는 Box 서버 프록시를 만든다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 필수 치수를 제거하거나 지원하지 않는 역할·모양 또는 잘못된 범위를 입력하면 프록시 생성이 거절되며 시각 자산이나 컴포넌트 fallback이 이를 복구하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: World Authority advances player motion from intent and authored proxy semantics
scenarios.titleKo: World Authority가 입력과 작성된 프록시 의미로 플레이어 이동을 전진시킨다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: At a fixed server tick, canonical locomotion intent, authored movement and jump tuning, an accepted authored jump occurrence, Zone bounds, and ontology collision proxies including an authored WalkableSupport produce the shared authoritative pose.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing required movement, jump, collision, or support semantics fails closed, and a client-resolved pose remains an ordered observation that cannot overwrite Authority motion.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 서버 고정 Tick에서 canonical 이동 입력, 작성된 이동·점프 튜닝, 승인된 작성 점프 발생, Zone 경계, 작성된 WalkableSupport를 포함한 온톨로지 충돌 프록시가 공유 권한 Pose를 생성합니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 필수 이동·점프·충돌·지지면 의미를 제거하면 fail-closed로 동작하며, 클라이언트가 해결한 Pose는 순서가 있는 관찰일 뿐 Authority 이동을 덮어쓸 수 없습니다.

scenarios.title: Authored support owns server grounding and local correction stays inside the single motion owner
scenarios.titleKo: 작성된 지지면이 서버 접지를 소유하고 로컬 보정은 단일 이동 소유자 안에서 수행된다

pipelineStages.trigger: World entry provisions one deterministic project-authored support entity and runtime snapshot polling observes later Authority poses.
pipelineStages.intentOrObservation: Local resolved motion remains an ephemeral observation; a newer owned Authority snapshot supplies only a bounded planar correction target.
pipelineStages.triples: The support entity authors WalkableSupport, Box proxy dimensions, StaticAnchored meaning, and a durable transform; the avatar authors maximum_step_height and ground_clearance.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: Not applicable to the passive static support geometry: it grants no action or behavior. Locomotion and jump still require their existing assigned Rule Blocks.
pipelineStages.evaluation: World Authority selects the highest authored support under the full actor footprint, applies step and clearance tuning, and fails closed when the support contract is absent.
pipelineStages.result: Server grounding, landing height, and support identity remain ephemeral motion state; support geometry itself is durable world data.
pipelineStages.authorityBoundary: The server pose is authoritative. Unity never writes it from a resolved-pose observation and never applies a direct Transform snap.
pipelineStages.meaning: StaticAnchored plus WalkableSupport selects passive collision meaning; LocalCharacterController selects the sole local movement adapter.
pipelineStages.adapter: Unity extrapolates a fresh planar snapshot within a bounded window and consumes the residual through the next and only CharacterController.Move call.
pipelineStages.removedPath: Removing or retiring the authored WalkableSupport removes server grounding, and stale snapshots or removed local motion ownership cannot produce correction.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: A complete authored support and player tuning contract produces server-owned support height while fresh planar Authority error is smoothed through the single local motion coordinator.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: No checkpoint-Y, prefab, mesh, static-collider, direct-Transform, or second-Move fallback restores grounding or reconciliation when the authored contracts are absent.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 완전한 작성 지지면과 플레이어 튜닝 계약이 서버 소유 지지 높이를 만들고, 최신 Authority 평면 오차는 단일 로컬 이동 코디네이터 안에서 부드럽게 보정됩니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 작성 계약이 없으면 체크포인트 Y, Prefab, Mesh, 정적 Collider, 직접 Transform 또는 두 번째 Move fallback이 접지나 보정을 복구하지 않습니다.

scenarios.title: World entry provisions the Authority runtime foundation before proximity actions
scenarios.titleKo: 월드 입장이 거리 제한 행동 전에 Authority 런타임 기반을 준비
scenarios.evidenceTest: [PASS] runtime Zone, motion readiness, legacy equipment migration
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A revisioned Zone, authored avatar movement speed, Zone checkpoint, ephemeral motion, canonical equipment, and animation intent complete in order.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Without an Authority motion state Unity does not submit proximity equip, and retired action-owned equips facts do not remain active.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 리비전 Zone, 작성된 아바타 이동 속도, Zone 체크포인트, 일시적 모션, 정식 장착, 애니메이션 의도가 순서대로 완료된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Authority 모션 상태가 없으면 Unity가 거리 제한 장착을 전송하지 않으며 폐기된 행동 소유 equips Fact도 활성 상태로 남지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Authored combat input submits only an Authority entity candidate
scenarios.titleKo: 작성 전투 입력은 Authority 엔티티 후보만 제출
scenarios.enabledExpectation: The authored attack action selects a projected entity and Authority evaluates equipment, target conditions, runtime range, and damage.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Camera look-hold cannot trigger attack; missing projection, hostile condition, runtime position, range, or damage produces no client fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 작성된 공격 행동이 투영 엔티티를 선택하고 Authority가 장착·대상 조건·런타임 거리·피해를 평가한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 카메라 시점 고정은 공격을 실행하지 않으며 투영·적대 조건·런타임 위치·거리·피해가 없으면 클라이언트 대체 동작이 없다.

scenarios.title: Required weapon grip metadata owns attachment alignment
scenarios.titleKo: 필수 무기 손잡이 메타데이터가 장착 정렬 소유
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A calibrated prefab grip aligns to the explicitly authored actor socket.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing the required grip or socket disables attachment presentation instead of using an actor-root or generic offset fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 보정된 프리팹 손잡이가 명시적으로 작성된 배우 소켓에 정렬된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 필수 손잡이 또는 소켓을 제거하면 배우 루트나 공통 오프셋 fallback 대신 장착 표현이 비활성화된다.

scenarios.title: Inflatable ring follows Triple, Rule Block, and Physical Meaning
scenarios.titleKo: 튜브의 트리플·룰블록·물리 의미 수직 슬라이스
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A canonical Actor near an authored wearable with the assigned equipment Rule Block is attached through its profile and receives its temporary swimming skill while the physical profile remains data-owned.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A clean run without the equipment Rule Block cannot create the slot relation, attachment, or temporary skill; Unity creates no hidden equipment fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: canonical Actor가 트리플과 장착 룰블록을 가진 튜브에 접근하면 프로필을 통해 장착되고, 데이터 소유 물리 프로필을 유지하면서 임시 수영 기술을 얻는다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 장착 룰블록을 제거하면 슬롯 관계·장착·임시 기술이 함께 사라지며 Unity는 숨은 장착 대체 동작을 만들지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Reusable gameplay logic is registered as a Rule Block before input integration
scenarios.titleKo: 재사용 게임 로직은 입력 연동보다 먼저 규칙 블록으로 등록

pipelineStages.trigger: F, click, collision, prompt, or another input source owns only the trigger.
pipelineStages.intentOrObservation: The input boundary emits canonical interaction_intent or a typed runtime observation.
pipelineStages.triples: The target authors capability, slot, attachment, and meaning/profile triples.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: EquipItemOnInteractionIntent is registered, published, assignable, and explicitly bound to each compatible object.
pipelineStages.evaluation: The ontology evaluator consumes the intent, triples, assigned block, and slot conditions.
pipelineStages.result: The evaluated block owns the origin-classified item equipped_by actor relation.
pipelineStages.authorityBoundary: Shared durable state is revisioned and projected by Authority; ephemeral intent remains runtime-only.
pipelineStages.meaning: The result selects explicit attachment and HandheldWeapon physical meaning; non-physical slices record their matching presentation meaning or N/A reason.
pipelineStages.adapter: OntologyAttachmentAdapter and the physical presentation coordinator consume the evaluated relation and profiles only.
pipelineStages.experience: The player sees and controls the attached object without becoming the owner of its gameplay rule.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: F, click, collision, or another trigger emits canonical intent; an assigned reusable Rule Block produces the equipment relation for any compatible object.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Without or after removal of the Rule Block, the relation is not produced; an Authority action or Unity adapter cannot duplicate equipped_by as a direct hidden effect.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: F, 클릭, 충돌 등의 트리거는 canonical Intent만 발행하고, 연결된 재사용 규칙 블록이 호환되는 모든 오브젝트의 장착 관계를 만듭니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 규칙 블록이 없거나 제거되면 관계가 생성되지 않으며 Authority 액션이나 Unity 어댑터가 equipped_by를 직접 만드는 숨겨진 효과를 둘 수 없습니다.

scenarios.title: Equipment input follows Triple, Rule Block, slot, and Physical Meaning
scenarios.titleKo: 장착 입력은 트리플·룰블록·슬롯·물리 의미를 따른다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Select/approach proximity equips a wearable through AutoEquipNearbyWearable, while F equips only a carried weapon through Authority; Waist and RightHand coexist through item-to-actor equipment state.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A missing matching Rule Block or an occupied authored slot prevents equip; F cannot attach or remove the wearable and Unity has no name-based permission fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 선택·접근 근접 흐름은 AutoEquipNearbyWearable을 통해 착용형을 장착하고 F는 Authority를 통해 운반형 무기만 장착하며, 아이템-배우 장착 상태에서 Waist와 RightHand는 함께 사용할 수 있다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 대응 룰블록이 없거나 작성 슬롯이 이미 사용 중이면 장착되지 않고 F는 착용형을 장착하거나 해제할 수 없으며 Unity에는 이름 기반 허용 fallback이 없다.

scenarios.title: Authority repairs orphaned equipment history and uniquely zonable legacy entities
scenarios.titleKo: Authority는 고아 장착 기록과 단일 구역에 속하는 구형 엔티티를 복구
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Entry requests idempotent Authority repair for orphaned attacks_with history and for an unzoned entity whose durable position belongs to exactly one authored Zone.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A matching equipped_by relation is preserved, and an entity in overlapping or no Zones is never assigned by guesswork.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 입장 시 고아 attacks_with 기록과 저장 위치가 정확히 하나의 작성 Zone에 속하는 무구역 엔티티를 Authority 멱등 명령으로 복구한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 대응 equipped_by 관계는 유지하며 여러 Zone에 겹치거나 어느 Zone에도 속하지 않는 엔티티는 추측으로 배정하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Authority avatar keeps its canonical Actor world role
scenarios.titleKo: Authority 아바타의 canonical Actor 월드 역할 유지
scenarios.enabledExpectation: New and repaired world avatars author has_concept Actor through a revisioned Authority fact before local Rule Block projection.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Account profile data is not copied into world facts, and Unity does not infer Actor from an object or prefab name.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 신규 및 복구된 월드 아바타는 로컬 룰블록 투영 전에 리비전 Authority Fact로 has_concept Actor를 작성한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 계정 프로필 데이터는 월드 Fact로 복사되지 않으며 Unity는 오브젝트명이나 프리팹명에서 Actor를 추론하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Ontology clip transitions use a normalized presentation mixer
scenarios.titleKo: 온톨로지 클립 전환은 정규화된 표현 믹서를 사용
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Manifest entries marked blendable cross-fade in a normalized clip mixer and keep the ontology presentation layer fully weighted.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Missing animation intent or actor repertoire produces no selected playback, and the mixer creates no gameplay fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 선택된 전신 클립은 정규화된 클립 믹서에서 크로스페이드되고 온톨로지 표현 레이어는 완전히 유지됩니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 애니메이션 의도나 액터 레퍼토리가 없으면 선택 재생이 없으며 믹서는 게임플레이 fallback을 만들지 않습니다.

scenarios.title: Non-blendable landing removes the stale airborne pose immediately
scenarios.titleKo: 블렌드 불가 착지는 이전 공중 포즈를 즉시 제거
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A Landing animation entry authored with canBlend disabled immediately receives full mixer weight and removes the prior Airborne pose.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: The presentation adapter does not override authored transition metadata with a hidden fixed-duration cross-fade.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: canBlend가 꺼진 착지 애니메이션 항목은 즉시 믹서 가중치 전체를 받고 이전 공중 포즈를 제거합니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 표현 어댑터는 작성된 전환 메타데이터를 숨은 고정 시간 크로스페이드로 덮어쓰지 않습니다.

scenarios.title: World entry settles collision presentation before input
scenarios.titleKo: 월드 입장은 입력 전에 충돌 표현을 지면에 정착
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Checkpoint data is restored first; an active but hidden and input-gated avatar then completes collision grounding, clears stale input and animation presentation, and opens input only after the session becomes InWorld.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A missing dependency, grounding timeout, or rejected checkpoint confirmation fails entry without exposing gameplay; swimming or mounted avatars are not force-grounded and no gameplay Fact is authored.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 체크포인트 데이터를 먼저 복원한 뒤 활성 상태지만 숨김·입력 차단된 아바타가 충돌 접지와 이전 입력·애니메이션 초기화를 완료하고, 세션이 InWorld가 된 뒤에만 입력을 엽니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 필수 구성 누락, 접지 시간 초과, 체크포인트 확인 거절은 게임플레이를 노출하지 않고 입장을 실패시키며, 수영·탑승 아바타를 강제 접지하거나 게임플레이 Fact를 작성하지 않습니다.

scenarios.title: Runtime Transform ownership is exclusive and data-selected
scenarios.titleKo: 런타임 Transform 소유권은 단일하며 데이터로 선택됨
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A Dynamic profile is seeded once, owns its live Rigidbody pose, checkpoints only a meaningful settled change, and restored player grounding clears ephemeral vertical velocity.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing Dynamic or attachment ownership returns control to durable projection, and a missing profile creates no hidden physics fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Dynamic 프로필은 한 번 초기화된 뒤 Rigidbody 실시간 위치를 소유하고 의미 있게 이동한 안정 상태만 저장하며 복원 접지는 임시 수직 속도를 초기화한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Dynamic 또는 장착 소유권을 제거하면 영속 투영으로 복귀하고 프로필 누락 시 숨은 물리 fallback을 만들지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Meaning-package outbox replay preserves nullable command contracts
scenarios.titleKo: 의미 패키지 보낼 편지함 재생은 nullable 명령 계약을 보존
scenarios.enabledExpectation: New and legacy meaning-package commands publish absent object entity IDs as JSON null, retain their idempotency keys, complete replay, and allow the session to reach InWorld.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Malformed payloads become completed Authority rejections; only an actual lost transport response remains queued and may keep entry in recovery.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 신규 및 기존 의미 패키지 명령은 없는 객체 엔티티 ID를 JSON null로 발행하고 멱등 키를 유지한 채 재생을 완료하여 세션이 InWorld에 도달한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 잘못된 payload는 완료된 Authority 거절이 되며, 실제 전송 응답 손실만 큐에 남아 입장을 복구 상태로 유지할 수 있다.

scenarios.title: Drowning recovery uses a fixed Authority checkpoint anchor
scenarios.titleKo: 익사 복구는 고정 Authority 체크포인트 기준을 사용
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An inferred Drowning relation owns movement before normal input, keeps advancing after it disables CharacterController, restores the avatar to the last confirmed dry checkpoint, persists that recovered pose once, and re-seeds Authority motion before reconciliation resumes.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Without Drowning, or after its retraction, Unity cannot trigger recovery; water, falling, and sinking presentation cannot overwrite the durable respawn anchor.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 추론된 Drowning 관계가 일반 입력보다 먼저 이동을 소유하고 CharacterController를 끈 뒤에도 계속 진행하여 아바타를 마지막 확정 마른 지면 체크포인트로 복구하며, 해당 위치를 한 번 저장한 뒤 Authority 모션을 재시드하고 보정을 재개한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Drowning이 없거나 철회되면 Unity가 복구를 실행할 수 없으며 물·추락·가라앉는 표현은 영속 리스폰 기준을 덮어쓰지 못한다.

scenarios.title: Player combat respawn is owned by an assigned Rule Block
scenarios.titleKo: 플레이어 전투 리스폰은 배정된 Rule Block이 소유
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A dead player avatar with respawn_action and RespawnPlayerOnDeath restores current_health from maximum_health through Authority before the world-entry locomotion handshake, becomes alive, and only then presents the confirmed checkpoint pose.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing the RespawnPlayerOnDeath binding causes Authority to reject the respawn intent; Unity does not revive health, life state, or checkpoint position through a hidden fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: respawn_action과 RespawnPlayerOnDeath를 가진 사망 플레이어 아바타는 Authority를 통해 maximum_health에서 current_health를 복구하고 생존 상태가 된 뒤에만 확정 체크포인트 위치를 표현한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: RespawnPlayerOnDeath 바인딩을 제거하면 Authority가 리스폰 의도를 거절하며 Unity는 숨은 fallback으로 체력·생존 상태·체크포인트 위치를 복구하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Immutable action history resolves to one active combat runtime contract
scenarios.titleKo: 불변 액션 이력은 하나의 활성 전투 런타임 계약으로 결정된다
scenarios.evidenceTest: Autonomous configuration selects the highest published action definition inside one enabled package; CombatTargetEligibilityRequiresProjectedLivingState; ResolvedPoseIsPublishedOnlyForAcceptedLocomotionLease; PlayerDamageRequiresFreshCollisionResolvedContact
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Historical immutable action versions may coexist, while one enabled package deterministically supplies the newest target, chase, and attack definitions; living projected targets remain selectable and a renewed locomotion lease supplies fresh collision-resolved contact evidence.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Multiple complete enabled packages, a missing assigned Rule Block, defeated lifecycle state, an expired locomotion lease, or stale/separated player contact evidence fails closed without a name, prefab, collider, or durable-position fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 과거 불변 액션 버전이 함께 존재해도 하나의 활성 패키지가 최신 대상 선택·추적·공격 정의를 결정적으로 제공하며, 살아 있는 투영 대상만 선택되고 갱신되는 이동 lease가 최신 충돌 해결 접촉 근거를 제공한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 완전한 활성 패키지가 둘 이상이거나 배정 Rule Block이 없거나 죽은 생명주기 상태이거나 이동 lease가 만료되거나 플레이어 접촉 관찰이 오래됐거나 떨어져 있으면 이름·프리팹·충돌체·영속 위치 대체 경로 없이 fail-closed 처리한다.

scenarios.title: Runtime placeable presentation follows Authority projection membership
scenarios.titleKo: 런타임 배치 오브젝트 표현은 Authority 투영 소속을 따른다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A projected weapon remains visible and versioned Rule Block migration leaves it with the assignable F-interaction contract.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A runtime placeable absent from Authority is removed, and the version-3 retirement removes only the stale automatic binding without restoring a user-removed replacement.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 투영된 무기는 계속 보이고 버전 기반 룰블록 마이그레이션 뒤 할당 가능한 F 상호작용 계약을 유지한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Authority에 없는 런타임 배치 오브젝트는 제거되고 버전 3 폐기는 사용자가 제거한 교체 규칙을 복원하지 않은 채 구형 자동 바인딩만 제거한다.

scenarios.title: Authority normalizes Unity-default optional effect metadata
scenarios.titleKo: Authority는 Unity 기본 선택 효과 메타데이터를 정규화한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A published Rule Block with a fully configured numeric source or guard evaluates with strict typed semantics.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A completely empty Unity-default source or guard is absent rather than an invalid hidden behavior; partially configured metadata remains rejected.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 완전히 설정된 수치 소스나 가드를 가진 발행 룰블록은 엄격한 타입 의미론으로 평가된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 완전히 빈 Unity 기본 소스·가드는 잘못된 숨은 행동이 아니라 미설정으로 처리되고 일부만 설정한 메타데이터는 계속 거부된다.

scenarios.title: Interruptible equipment presentation yields directly to locomotion
scenarios.titleKo: 중단 가능한 장착 표현은 이동 표현으로 즉시 전환된다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Movement during an interruptible WeaponEquip or WeaponUnequip presentation immediately selects the catalog-owned WeaponWalk intent without requiring an idle frame.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A transient entry authored as non-interruptible does not yield to movement, and no weapon-name or Unity fallback manufactures a locomotion intent.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 중단 가능한 WeaponEquip 또는 WeaponUnequip 표현 중 이동하면 Idle 프레임 없이 카탈로그 소유 WeaponWalk 의도를 즉시 선택한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 중단 불가로 작성한 일시적 표현은 이동에 양보하지 않으며 무기명이나 Unity fallback이 이동 의도를 만들지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Unrelated projection revisions preserve accepted locomotion
scenarios.titleKo: 관계없는 Projection 변경은 승인된 이동을 유지한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: The explicit zero-motion entry handshake runs before automatic lease recovery; afterward monster damage and unrelated avatar combat/equipment changes preserve an accepted locomotion contract, and authored gravity continues settling the capsule.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Changing or removing the avatar's own locomotion Fact, Rule Block binding, world/Zone scope, or immutable action invalidates prediction until Authority accepts it again.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 명시적 0 이동량 입장 검증이 자동 lease 복구보다 먼저 실행되며, 이후 몬스터 피해와 이동과 무관한 아바타 전투·장착 변경은 승인된 이동 계약을 유지하고 작성된 중력이 캡슐을 접지시킨다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 아바타 자신의 이동 Fact, Rule Block 배정, 월드/Zone 범위 또는 불변 액션이 변경·제거되면 Authority가 다시 승인할 때까지 예측 이동을 중단한다.

scenarios.title: Player jump is Rule-Block gated and uses one collision owner
scenarios.titleKo: 플레이어 점프는 Rule Block으로 제한되고 하나의 충돌 소유자를 사용한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A complete avatar jump contract and positive grounded observation receive Authority approval; authored takeoff, gravity, ground stick, correction, and controller impulse use one CharacterController move, while a temporary Rigidbody reaction takes exclusive ownership.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing jump_action or JumpPlayerFromIntent, omitting grounded observation, or removing impact meaning prevents only that route without a Space-key, name-based, second-Move, or concurrent-physics fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 완전한 아바타 점프 계약과 참인 접지 관측은 Authority 승인을 받고, 작성된 이륙·중력·접지·보정·컨트롤러 임펄스는 하나의 CharacterController Move를 사용하며 임시 Rigidbody 반응은 배타적으로 소유권을 가져갑니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: jump_action이나 JumpPlayerFromIntent를 제거하거나 접지 관측·충격 의미가 없으면 Space 키·이름 분기·두 번째 Move·동시 물리 fallback 없이 해당 경로만 중단됩니다.

scenarios.title: Actor profile animation repertoire survives runtime world replacement
scenarios.titleKo: ActorProfile 애니메이션 레퍼토리는 런타임 월드 교체 뒤 다시 투영된다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A Manifest-synchronized ActorProfile republishes its current has_animation contributions after WorldRebuilt, so existing compatible actors can select newly registered presentation content.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing an animation from the profile retracts its ActorProfile-origin contribution and no stale clip, animation-id branch, or character-name fallback restores it.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Manifest와 동기화된 ActorProfile은 WorldRebuilt 뒤 현재 has_animation 기여분을 다시 투영하여 기존 호환 Actor도 새로 등록된 표현 콘텐츠를 선택할 수 있습니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 프로필에서 애니메이션을 제거하면 ActorProfile 원본 기여분이 철회되며 오래된 클립·애니메이션 ID 분기·캐릭터 이름 fallback이 이를 복원하지 않습니다.

scenarios.title: One approved jump produces one in-place presentation lifecycle
scenarios.titleKo: 승인된 점프 한 번은 인플레이스 표현 생명 주기를 한 번만 만든다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: One approved ephemeral jump occurrence advances JumpStart, separately authored Airborne and Fall presentation segments, and contact-confirmed Landing once; only after the landing segment completes may presentation blend to authored Idle or equipment idle while CharacterController remains the sole world-motion owner.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: An invalid or missing segment, shared apex/fall presentation identity, inherited/enabled jump root motion, support proximity without controller contact, a duplicate approval after support is consumed, or an upward landing segment fails validation or cannot manufacture landing, Idle, or a second jump occurrence.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 승인된 일시적 점프 발생 한 번은 JumpStart, 별도로 작성된 Airborne·Fall 표현 구간, 실제 접촉으로 확정된 Landing을 한 번씩 통과하며, 착지 구간이 끝난 뒤에만 작성된 Idle 또는 장착 Idle로 블렌딩하고 CharacterController만 월드 이동을 소유합니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 잘못되거나 누락된 구간, 정점·낙하 표현 ID 공유, 상속/활성 점프 Root Motion, 컨트롤러 접촉 없는 지지면 근접, 지지면 소비 뒤 중복 승인, 상승하는 착지 구간은 검증에 실패하거나 착지·Idle·두 번째 점프를 만들어낼 수 없습니다.

scenarios.title: Manifest-authored attack presentation yields to locomotion
scenarios.titleKo: Manifest에 작성된 공격 표현이 이동 표현에 양보한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Movement after AttackLight immediately selects the catalog-owned locomotion presentation when the source manifest marks the attack interruptible.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing movement intent or authoring the transient as non-interruptible retains the attack presentation; Unity creates no permission, Fact, or hidden weapon-name fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 원본 Manifest가 AttackLight를 중단 가능으로 명시하면 공격 후 이동 시 카탈로그 소유 이동 표현을 즉시 선택한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 이동 의도가 없거나 표현이 중단 불가로 작성되면 공격 표현을 유지하며 Unity는 권한, Fact 또는 무기명 기반 숨은 대체 동작을 만들지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Animation wizard registers through the validated manifest production line
scenarios.titleKo: 애니메이션 위자드는 검증된 Manifest 생산 라인으로 등록한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A wizard-authored animation is first validated in AnimationContentManifest, then projected into AnimationDatabase and the assigned ActorProfile; Authority action intents resolve against that same manifest.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing the manifest entry removes the generated Database and Profile membership, while direct Database-only registration and hardcoded semantic properties are not allowed.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 위자드에서 만든 애니메이션은 AnimationContentManifest에서 먼저 검증된 뒤 AnimationDatabase와 지정 ActorProfile에 투영되고 Authority 행동 의도도 같은 Manifest를 기준으로 확인한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Manifest 항목을 제거하면 생성된 Database 정의와 Profile 소속도 제거되며 Database 직접 등록이나 의미 속성 하드코딩은 허용하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Current animation assets remain synchronized with the manifest
scenarios.titleKo: 현재 애니메이션 자산은 Manifest 투영과 일치한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Base, equipment, attack, and recovery animations have matching Manifest, Database, and Profile data, and Authority action intents resolve against the same manifest.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A missing or mismatched manifest entry, runtime definition, profile membership, or Authority intent fails verification instead of creating a Unity fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 기본·장착·공격·회복 애니메이션의 Manifest·Database·Profile 데이터가 일치하고 Authority 행동 의도도 같은 Manifest에서 해석된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Manifest 항목·런타임 정의·Profile 소속·Authority 의도 중 하나라도 없거나 다르면 Unity fallback을 만들지 않고 검증에 실패한다.

scenarios.title: Primary melee attack follows the complete ontology production line
scenarios.titleKo: 기본 근접 공격은 전체 온톨로지 생산 라인을 따른다

productionContract.appliesTo: Every new, migrated, generated, or user-authored weapon

stages.resource: Register visual, explicit contact proxy, VFX, and catalog references in project-owned content without deriving gameplay from asset names.
stages.triples: Author Item/Weapon capability, equipment slot, action IDs, integer damage, range, cooldown, contact mode/open/window/reach, physical profile, attachment profile, and collision proxy tuning as canonical data.
stages.ruleBlocks: Assign reusable equipment, swing-presentation, and target-damage Rule Blocks; each behavior must disappear when its block is removed.
stages.actions: Publish immutable equip, unequip, swing, and attack actions that invoke their matching assigned Rule Blocks; durable attack requires an Authority-owned occurrence.
stages.physicalMeaning: Resolve HandheldWeapon Physical Meaning plus authored attachment socket, grip alignment, and explicit adjustable weapon contact volume.
stages.animationManifest: Validate equipment locomotion and attack animation intents, normalized contact window, and VFX references through the manifest/catalog production line.
stages.authority: World Authority previews eligibility, creates one ephemeral player AttackOccurrence, validates authored capsule contact during its authored window, consumes it exactly once, and only then invokes the immutable damage action and assigned Rule Block.
stages.unityPresentation: Unity derives approach distance from explicit authored contact proxies, reports only a projected candidate inside the contact window, and presents accepted animation/VFX without creating damage state.
stages.removedPath: Executable evidence removes the required Rule Block, occurrence, contact data, explicit proxy, or semantic stage and proves attack behavior disappears without a hidden fallback.

forbiddenImplementations: mesh-name, prefab-name, or object-name gameplay branches
Unity-owned equipment, damage, death, or other durable gameplay outcomes
action effects that duplicate assigned Rule Block results
fallback behavior that survives required Rule Block removal
animation or VFX registration that bypasses the validated manifest or catalog

pipelineStages.trigger: Player/Attack maps left mouse click and owns only the trigger.
pipelineStages.intentOrObservation: Unity transports projected actor, target, and equipped-tool identities to request one Authority occurrence, then reports only an ephemeral approved-target contact candidate during the authored window.
pipelineStages.triples: The weapon authors attack_action, attack_damage, attack_range, attack_cooldown, attack_contact_mode, MeleeAttack capability, and its profiles.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: MeleeAttackOnPrimaryIntent requires the authored WeaponContactWindow mode, is published and assignable, and remains bound on the equipped tool.
pipelineStages.evaluation: World Authority previews the bound immutable attack and swing rules first. At reported contact it re-evaluates actor, tool, target, faction hostility, life, equipment, runtime positions, authored capsule geometry, reach, range, cooldown, and contact-delivery semantics before consuming the occurrence once.
pipelineStages.result: The Rule Block adjusts current_health and conditionally produces death and loot results with rule-binding provenance.
pipelineStages.authorityBoundary: Durable results use one revisioned idempotent Authority command after an exactly-once ephemeral occurrence; direct generic execution without that resolved occurrence fails closed, while positions and cooldown leases remain ephemeral.
pipelineStages.meaning: HandheldWeapon physical meaning, the prefab-authored contact volume, and the AttackLight manifest contact window select when an approved impact may be requested.
pipelineStages.adapter: Targeting, animation, weapon-contact, and VFX adapters consume projected data and accepted presentation intent; the facing adapter aligns the actor before intent publication, oriented contact surfaces select a conservative navigation stop, actor/target collider surfaces impose a non-overlapping minimum body clearance, adjacent pre-window poses seed continuous contact without owning damage, and the sweep adapter orients presentation from blade-axis and motion observations.
pipelineStages.experience: A nearby hostile target can be attacked with left click. The player approaches until the oriented weapon surface can physically reach without overlapping the two character bodies, the slash plane follows the actual swing, and damage and impact feedback occur only when that weapon overlaps the approved target.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: A projected weapon with attack_contact_mode, a validated animation contact window, and the assigned MeleeAttackOnPrimaryIntent block requests Authority damage only after overlapping the approved target.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing the attack Rule Block, contact-mode Triple, animation contact window, or actual approved-target overlap prevents damage and impact feedback; no timing or raycast fallback remains.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: attack_contact_mode, 검증된 애니메이션 접촉 구간, MeleeAttackOnPrimaryIntent 블록이 갖춰진 투영 무기는 승인 대상과 실제로 겹친 뒤에만 Authority 피해를 요청한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 공격 룰블록, 접촉 모드 트리플, 애니메이션 접촉 구간, 승인 대상과의 실제 겹침 중 하나라도 없으면 피해와 타격 표현이 발생하지 않으며 시간·레이캐스트 fallback은 없다.

scenarios.title: Shared left click approaches and attacks a living hostile through authored range
scenarios.titleKo: 공유 왼쪽 클릭은 작성된 사거리에 맞춰 살아 있는 적대 대상에게 접근하고 공격한다

pipelineStages.trigger: Player/Attack shares left mouse click with click-to-move and owns only input routing.
pipelineStages.intentOrObservation: Unity reports a projected pointer candidate and authored action IDs; exact combat hits take priority, and a terrain hit directly beneath an unobstructed authored combat collider may recover that same observation. Unity does not classify hostility, life state, Rule Block assignment, or range.
pipelineStages.triples: The weapon authors swing_action and attack_playback_speed alongside its attack capability and tuning triples.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: SwingWeaponOnPrimaryIntent owns AttackLight presentation and declares the tool's attack_playback_speed Triple as its numeric source; MeleeAttackOnPrimaryIntent independently owns target damage.
pipelineStages.evaluation: World Authority previews attack and swing through the same prepared action and assigned Rule Block path used by execution, resolves one positive bounded playback rate, and returns it only with the accepted presentation.
pipelineStages.result: A projected living combat-target click is reserved while preview is pending. Out-of-range rejection starts ephemeral approach navigation using the tool's authored range; accepted preview runs the swing and separate durable damage action.
pipelineStages.authorityBoundary: Preview applies no mutations, acquires no cooldown, and advances no revision; runtime presentation stays ephemeral while target damage remains revisioned and idempotent.
pipelineStages.meaning: HandheldWeapon physical meaning and the validated animation manifest resolve the approved AttackLight intent.
pipelineStages.adapter: Unity targeting reports only a projected entity candidate. It scans past non-combat projected hits and may disambiguate a narrowly missed target from the authored collider footprint plus editable presentation padding and line of sight. The animation adapter applies the Authority-approved playback multiplier to the selected clip playable; it never reads the weapon Triple directly.
pipelineStages.experience: Left click attacks a nearby eligible monster or approaches an out-of-range living combat target once. Busy and cooldown states never leak the same click into terrain movement.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: With attack and swing data and Rule Blocks assigned, a living hostile consumes left click, is approached to the data-authored attack_range when necessary, and follows Authority-approved presentation plus separate damage evaluation without move/attack oscillation.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing either required Rule Block, the hostile/alive Facts, or a unique positive attack_range removes the combat input route; Unity supplies no fallback and the click remains available to movement.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 공격·휘두르기 데이터와 룰블록이 배정되면 살아 있는 적대 대상이 왼쪽 클릭을 소비하고 필요하면 데이터로 작성된 attack_range까지 접근한 뒤 이동·공격 진동 없이 Authority 승인 표현과 별도 피해 평가를 따른다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 필요한 룰블록, 적대·생존 Fact, 유일한 양수 attack_range 중 하나라도 제거하면 전투 입력 경로가 사라지고 Unity fallback 없이 클릭은 이동 입력으로 남는다.

scenarios.title: An empty legacy migration ledger may be adopted only from verified compatible schema
scenarios.titleKo: 비어 있는 기존 마이그레이션 ledger는 호환 스키마 검증 후에만 채택할 수 있다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A completely empty legacy ledger can be baselined through migration 016 only after every required schema and ownership-backfill fingerprint passes and the operator supplies -Apply.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A partial ledger, missing schema fingerprint, incomplete ownership backfill, or ordinary dry run writes no ledger rows; data-repair migration 017 is never inferred from schema.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 완전히 비어 있는 기존 ledger는 필요한 모든 스키마와 소유권 백필 fingerprint가 통과하고 운영자가 -Apply를 지정한 경우에만 migration 016까지 기준선으로 채택한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 부분 ledger, 누락된 스키마 fingerprint, 불완전한 소유권 백필 또는 일반 dry run은 ledger를 쓰지 않으며 데이터 복구 migration 017은 스키마만으로 적용되었다고 추론하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Required SQL migrations are verified before runtime service acceptance
scenarios.titleKo: 필수 SQL 마이그레이션을 런타임 서비스 사용 전에 검증한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: With -RequireServices, every ordered repository migration is recorded in platform_schema_migrations before the development harness accepts the local stack.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A healthy PostgreSQL process with one or more pending repository migrations fails readiness and cannot be mistaken for a compatible Authority database.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: -RequireServices 사용 시 개발 하네스가 로컬 스택을 승인하기 전에 저장소의 모든 순서형 마이그레이션이 platform_schema_migrations에 기록되어 있다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: PostgreSQL 프로세스가 정상이어도 저장소 마이그레이션이 남아 있으면 준비 검증을 실패하여 호환되는 Authority DB로 오인하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Rule and Action payload changes require reviewed immutable identities before play
scenarios.titleKo: 규칙과 액션 payload 변경은 플레이 전에 검토된 새 불변 ID를 요구한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Every configured development Rule and Action identity matches the reviewed deterministic source checksum in the committed release manifest.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Changing authored payload content without first advancing and reviewing its immutable definition version fails the development harness before world entry.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 설정된 모든 개발 규칙과 액션 ID가 커밋된 릴리스 매니페스트의 검토된 결정적 소스 checksum과 일치한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 불변 정의 버전을 먼저 올리고 검토하지 않은 payload 변경은 월드 입장 전에 개발 하네스를 실패시킨다.

scenarios.title: Immutable content is verified before play without publishing during world entry
scenarios.titleKo: 불변 콘텐츠는 플레이 전에 검증되며 월드 입장 중 발행되지 않는다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Entry verifies the immutable content payload and prepared avatar semantics through read-only Authority queries before pending-command recovery, ephemeral runtime activation, and the final admission commit.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Content publication, zone or avatar provisioning, semantic repair, legacy migration, or readiness checks ordered after recovery or activation fail development verification before play.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 검토된 콘텐츠 릴리스 매니페스트를 개발 하네스가 검증하고, 입장은 아바타나 월드를 변경하기 전에 읽기 전용 패키지 사전 검사를 수행한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 기존 불변 ID 아래 payload 변경, 입장 중 콘텐츠 POST, 영속 준비 이후에 배치된 사전 검사는 플레이 전에 개발 검증을 실패시킨다.

scenarios.title: Empty optional Rule Block presentation preserves immutable identity
scenarios.titleKo: 비어 있는 선택적 룰블록 표현은 기존 불변 식별값을 보존한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A configured runtime presentation remains hashed immutable Rule Block content and requires normal definition versioning.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A missing or Unity-empty runtimePresentation is canonicalized to the same legacy payload and cannot create a false rule_definition_version_conflict.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 설정된 런타임 표현은 해시되는 불변 룰블록 콘텐츠로 유지되며 일반적인 정의 버전 관리를 요구한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 필드가 없거나 Unity가 빈 runtimePresentation을 보낸 경우 같은 기존 payload로 canonicalize되어 잘못된 rule_definition_version_conflict를 만들지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Any placed entity can become an autonomous monster through the complete ontology contract
scenarios.titleKo: 어떤 배치 엔티티도 완전한 온톨로지 계약으로 자율 몬스터가 될 수 있다

productionContract.appliesTo: Every new, migrated, generated, or user-authored autonomous monster

stages.resource: Register the visual prefab, collider, catalog, and VFX references as project-owned presentation content without deriving behavior from their names.
stages.triples: Author Actor, AutonomousAgent, Monster, Combatant, Damageable, faction, hostility, target_concept, targeting_profile, chase_profile, placement-time life defaults, movement, detection, leash, collision capsule radius/height, attack contact reach, attack range/damage/cooldown, attack windup/recovery timing, loot lifecycle, action, and animation-intent canonical data. Mutable current_health and is_alive belong to lifecycle state and must never be reintroduced by a semantic-baseline migration.
stages.ruleBlocks: Assign reusable target acquisition, chase, autonomous attack, defeat-loot, and collection Rule Blocks; removing any block disables only its matching behavior.
stages.actions: Publish immutable target, chase, and attack actions whose declared rule invocations match the active Rule Block bindings on the actor. Target and chase actions are explicitly evaluation-only and may not mutate durable state.
stages.physicalMeaning: Assign AuthorityKinematic Physical Meaning so World Authority owns autonomous motion while Unity only interpolates it.
stages.animationManifest: Validate idle, locomotion, attack, hit, death, and optional VFX intents through the animation manifest and compatible ActorProfile.
stages.authority: World Authority owns zone scheduling and selects the highest published target, chase, and attack definition version inside the one enabled package before previewing its assigned Rule definitions. The current living projection evicts stale runtime occurrences every tick. An ephemeral AttackOccurrence advances through windup, one authored-capsule contact revalidation, and recovery; only accepted contact executes damage and immediately publishes its durable revision.
stages.unityPresentation: Unity creates combat presentation from the projected Damageable semantic, interpolates accepted poses, and presents canonical animation/VFX intents without evaluating hostility, range, rules, damage, or loot ownership.
stages.removedPath: Executable evidence removes the Rule Block, action link, required semantic data, or Physical Meaning and proves autonomous behavior disappears without a hidden fallback.

forbiddenImplementations: mesh-name, prefab-name, object-name, or placement-category gameplay branches
Unity-owned target selection, hostility, damage, death, or autonomous simulation
Authority or action branches that bypass or duplicate the assigned Rule Block
fallback behavior that survives Rule Block or semantic contract removal
animation registration that bypasses the validated manifest and ActorProfile

pipelineStages.trigger: The active zone scheduler emits an autonomous attack attempt only for a fully configured semantic actor.
pipelineStages.intentOrObservation: Ephemeral player and autonomous actor positions provide target and motion observations without durable per-frame Facts.
pipelineStages.triples: Concept, faction, hostility, target concept, targeting/chase profiles, life, movement, range, loot lifecycle, action and animation-intent data are authored on the selected entity.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: The actor has enabled target-acquisition, chase and autonomous-attack Rule Blocks matching the immutable actions and runtime profiles; defeat and collection have their own blocks.
pipelineStages.evaluation: World Authority evaluates the actor's immutable target action and assigned target Rule for every candidate, then evaluates the immutable chase action and assigned chase Rule before movement; attack uses the same action-to-Rule path.
pipelineStages.result: An accepted attack preview creates one ephemeral occurrence. Its contact tick revalidates the assigned Rule Block, current living eligibility, live positions, vertical overlap and authored capsule contact exactly once; accepted damage and death are durable while windup, recovery, motion and animation remain ephemeral.
pipelineStages.authorityBoundary: Zone leases prevent duplicate simulation, occurrence state prevents duplicate contact, and committed damage publishes an immediate revision notification while retaining revisioned idempotent mutation.
pipelineStages.meaning: AuthorityKinematic Physical Meaning selects server-owned actor motion without depending on a prefab or object name.
pipelineStages.adapter: Unity derives the combat presenter from projected Damageable meaning, interpolates accepted motion, and resolves canonical animation intent from the synchronized catalog.
pipelineStages.experience: Applying the preset can make a Beholder, log or other placed visual behave as the same data-defined monster.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: A fully authored entity moves toward a hostile live player and attacks through its assigned Rule Block and action definition.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing the Rule Block, action-to-rule link, required semantics or Physical Meaning removes autonomous behavior with no hidden fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 계약이 완성된 엔티티는 적대 관계의 살아 있는 플레이어에게 이동하고 배정된 Rule Block과 액션 정의로 공격합니다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Rule Block, 액션-규칙 연결, 필수 의미, 물리 의미 중 하나를 제거하면 숨은 fallback 없이 자율 행동이 제거됩니다.

scenarios.title: Player ground-combat foundation follows the complete ontology production line
scenarios.titleKo: 플레이어 지상 전투 기반은 전체 온톨로지 생산 라인을 따른다

productionContract.appliesTo: Every new, migrated, generated, or user-authored player gameplay capability

stages.resource: Keep account-owned appearance/profile resources separate from the durable world avatar entity and register presentation assets through project-owned catalogs.
stages.triples: Author player role, capability, life, faction, locomotion/jump action IDs, movement/sprint/gravity/jump/ground-stick/maximum-step/ground-clearance tuning, impact-response meaning, physical profile, collision role/proxy shape/dimensions, and idle/move/hit/death animation-intent canonical data on the world avatar.
stages.ruleBlocks: Assign reusable ground-locomotion, grounded-jump, equipment, attack, death, and respawn Rule Blocks as applicable; removing a required block removes its behavior.
stages.actions: Publish immutable player actions that invoke the matching assigned Rule Blocks; transient input carries the selected action identity.
stages.physicalMeaning: Use LocalCharacterController Physical Meaning for local prediction and author ActorBody Capsule proxy data for the server collision boundary; controller impulses join one local move and a temporary Rigidbody reaction must take exclusive ownership.
stages.animationManifest: Validate idle, locomotion, equipment, attack, hit, death, recovery, and respawn intents through the animation manifest and PlayerProfile.
stages.authority: World Authority evaluates every shared locomotion/action request and advances shared player motion at a fixed tick from authored speed, jump, gravity, step, clearance, Zone, and collision-proxy semantics including explicit WalkableSupport. Client-resolved poses remain ephemeral observations tied only to an active accepted locomotion intent and never overwrite Authority state.
stages.unityPresentation: Unity captures input and presents local prediction, animation, collision, bounded planar reconciliation, and feedback through the single CharacterController.Move owner while consuming Authority motion; it never restores behavior rejected by Authority.
stages.removedPath: Executable evidence removes the locomotion action or Rule Block and proves both Unity prediction and Authority scheduling/evaluation stop without a hidden fallback.

forbiddenImplementations: account appearance or login preferences stored as world Facts
prefab-name, object-name, input binding, or animation-name gameplay permission
Unity-owned durable movement, damage, death, equipment, or respawn results
legacy CharacterMover, MovePlayerInput, or a second project-owned Transform movement driver in the TOV runtime
implicit walkable support inferred only because a Unity collider is static
Authority endpoints or schedulers that bypass the assigned Rule Block and action definition
client-resolved coordinates that directly overwrite World Authority motion state
entry-time repair that silently restores user-removed versioned semantics

pipelineStages.trigger: Keyboard, jump, click navigation, equip, attack, and respawn input own only the user trigger.
pipelineStages.intentOrObservation: Unity emits transient canonical intent with the selected immutable action identity; position, grounding, target, and equipment state remain observations or projections, and grounded observation is not persisted.
pipelineStages.triples: The durable world avatar authors PlayerControlled role, capabilities, life, faction, locomotion/jump action IDs, movement/gravity/takeoff/ground-stick/maximum-step/ground-clearance tuning, impact-response meaning, Physical Meaning, collision role/proxy shape/dimensions, and animation intents. Durable support entities independently author WalkableSupport Box geometry.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: MovePlayerFromIntent, JumpPlayerFromIntent, and the applicable equipment, attack, and respawn blocks are explicitly assigned to their semantic owners; removing the jump block removes jump approval.
pipelineStages.evaluation: World Authority evaluates the immutable action and matching enabled Rule Block against current facts before accepting shared motion or gameplay results.
pipelineStages.result: Locomotion approval and motion stay ephemeral; equipment, damage, death, loot, and life restoration follow their existing revisioned Authority result paths.
pipelineStages.authorityBoundary: Input samples do not advance world revision, while durable shared changes use revisioned idempotent commands and projected results.
pipelineStages.meaning: LocalCharacterController selects the current collision-resolved presentation owner, impact_response_profile selects a collision-response adapter, and canonical animation intents select presentation without granting permission.
pipelineStages.adapter: Unity combines approved horizontal motion, gravity, jump, bounded planar Authority reconciliation, and controller impulse into one CharacterController move; a configured temporary Rigidbody response takes exclusive ownership and restores it after settling.
pipelineStages.experience: The player can move, equip a weapon, hunt a semantic monster, die, and respawn only while the corresponding authored contracts are complete.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: A versioned player avatar with complete locomotion and jump triples, assigned MovePlayerFromIntent and JumpPlayerFromIntent blocks, immutable actions, grounded observation, and LocalCharacterController meaning can move and follow an approved parabolic jump through one local CharacterController owner.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing locomotion_action, jump_action, either required Rule Block, required tuning/meaning, or grounded observation rejects only the affected route; Unity has no input, name-based, or hidden physics fallback and versioned entry does not restore the removal.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 완전한 이동·점프 트리플, 배정된 MovePlayerFromIntent·JumpPlayerFromIntent 규칙 블록, 불변 액션, 접지 관측, LocalCharacterController 의미가 있는 버전 관리 플레이어는 하나의 로컬 CharacterController 소유자로 이동하고 승인된 포물선 점프를 수행한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: locomotion_action, jump_action, 필수 규칙 블록, 필수 튜닝·의미, 접지 관측 중 하나를 제거하면 해당 경로만 거절되며 Unity 입력·이름 분기·숨은 물리 fallback이 없고 재입장도 제거 상태를 복구하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Equipment, player motion, autonomous combat, presentation and loot use one rule-owned Authority pipeline
scenarios.titleKo: 장착·플레이어 이동·자율 전투·표현·전리품은 하나의 규칙 소유 Authority 파이프라인을 사용한다

pipelineStages.trigger: F, movement, autonomous ticks, defeat and collection publish only canonical intent or observations.
pipelineStages.triples: Canonical action IDs, ranges, profiles, tuning, target concepts and lifecycle state are authored data rather than Unity constants.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: Equip, unequip, locomotion, target, chase, attack, defeat-loot and collection are individually assigned reusable Rule Blocks.
pipelineStages.evaluation: World Authority evaluates immutable actions and explicitly declared post Rule Block invocations against the latest projection.
pipelineStages.result: Shared or durable relations, health, life and loot provenance change only through revisioned idempotent Authority results.
pipelineStages.meaning: Physical Meaning and canonical presentation intents select runtime adapters after rule evaluation.
pipelineStages.adapter: Unity resolves projected action/range data and dynamically presents Damageable entities without prefab, mesh or object-name behavior branches.
pipelineStages.removedPath: Removing the action Triple, required Rule Block, target/chase profile, Damageable meaning or post-rule binding removes only the corresponding route with no fallback.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: Any compatible authored player, weapon or monster completes the same data -> Rule Block -> Authority -> meaning/adapter contract.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing a required contract stage stops that behavior and does not preserve a Unity, endpoint, name-based or direct-effect fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 호환되는 임의의 플레이어·무기·몬스터는 같은 데이터 -> Rule Block -> Authority -> 의미/Adapter 계약으로 동작한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 필수 계약 단계를 제거하면 해당 행동이 중단되고 Unity·엔드포인트·이름 분기·직접 효과 fallback이 남지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Durable entity retirement removes projection membership through Authority
scenarios.titleKo: Authority 영속 엔티티 폐기가 Projection 소속을 제거
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A revisioned retire_entity command soft-deletes one arbitrary world entity, closes its active Triples, Rule Blocks and meaning package applications, clears autonomous runtime state, and removes the Unity presentation only after projection confirmation.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A new command cannot retire an already absent entity, account avatars are protected, defeat alone does not imply retirement, and local previews use only the local fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: revision 기반 retire_entity 명령이 임의의 월드 엔티티를 소프트 삭제하고 활성 트리플·Rule Block·의미 패키지를 종료하며 자율 행동 임시 상태를 지운 뒤 Projection 확인으로 Unity 표현을 제거한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 새 명령으로 이미 없는 엔티티를 다시 폐기할 수 없고 계정 아바타는 보호되며, 처치만으로 폐기되지 않고 로컬 미리보기만 로컬 삭제 경로를 사용한다.

scenarios.title: Player-facing runtime data resolves through language keys without changing canonical ontology IDs
scenarios.titleKo: 사용자용 런타임 데이터는 canonical 온톨로지 ID를 바꾸지 않고 언어팩 키로 표시된다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Account status, catalog content, shipped quests, combat feedback, templates, parts and ontology summaries resolve in English and Korean from keys and arguments.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Missing keys fail project coverage validation, while user-authored free text remains unchanged and canonical IDs never become localized save data.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 계정 상태, 카탈로그 콘텐츠, 기본 퀘스트, 전투 안내, 템플릿, 파츠, 온톨로지 요약이 키와 인자로 영문·한글 표시된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 키가 누락되면 프로젝트 커버리지 검증이 실패하고, 사용자 자유 입력은 원문을 유지하며 canonical ID는 번역된 저장 데이터로 바뀌지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Generated entity identity stays durable while localized presentation hides internal suffixes
scenarios.titleKo: 생성 엔티티 식별자는 영속 유지하고 다국어 표시에서는 내부 접미사를 숨긴다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Known generated GUID/ordinal suffixes resolve to the catalog-localized base name, registered referenced Concepts resolve in both languages, and user-authored names remain unchanged.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: An unregistered referenced Concept fails coverage validation, and an arbitrary or user-authored suffix is never stripped or written back to Authority.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 확인된 GUID/순번 접미사는 카탈로그 다국어 기본 이름으로 표시되고 참조한 등록 Concept는 양 언어로 해석되며 사용자 작성 이름은 유지된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 참조한 미등록 Concept는 커버리지 검증을 실패시키며 임의 또는 사용자 작성 접미사는 제거하거나 Authority에 다시 쓰지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Project-owned game UI uses one idempotent Jua typography policy
scenarios.titleKo: 프로젝트 소유 게임 UI가 재실행 안전한 하나의 Jua 타이포그래피 정책을 사용한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: All project-owned TMP text uses Jua, interactive controls gain exactly 2 points once, and authored non-typographic UI values remain unchanged.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Re-running the migration does not increase point sizes again, and third-party UI assets are never changed.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 프로젝트 소유 모든 TMP 텍스트가 Jua를 사용하고 상호작용 컨트롤은 한 번만 정확히 2포인트 커지며 글꼴 외 UI 작성값은 유지된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 마이그레이션을 다시 실행해도 포인트가 추가로 커지지 않으며 서드파티 UI 자산은 변경하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Ontology data-panel semantics resolve through language keys without changing canonical IDs
scenarios.titleKo: 온톨로지 데이터 패널 의미가 canonical ID를 바꾸지 않고 언어팩 키로 표시된다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Titles, tabs, actions, durable relations and values, rule variables, physical choices, and readable results resolve in English and Korean through registered keys.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A missing term, fact template, physical display key, duplicate key, or ambiguous alias fails localization validation while canonical world data remains unchanged.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 제목, 탭, 동작, 지속 관계와 값, 규칙 변수, 물리 선택지와 읽기 쉬운 결과가 등록 키를 통해 한글·영문으로 표시된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 용어, 팩트 템플릿, 물리 표시 키가 빠지거나 키·별칭이 중복되면 언어팩 검증이 실패하며 canonical 월드 데이터는 변경되지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Autonomous combat availability and accepted state use explicit Authority contracts
scenarios.titleKo: 자율 전투 가용성과 승인 상태가 명시적인 Authority 계약을 따른다

pipelineStages.trigger: An authenticated Unity client enters a projected Zone and renews an ephemeral HTTP runtime-session lease.
pipelineStages.triples: Action-reference relations preserve exact immutable IDs and single-cardinality meaning data replaces legacy aliases.
pipelineStages.ruleBlock: Every effect declares whether its result is RuleBound behavior state or a DurableState transition.
pipelineStages.evaluation: World Authority evaluates target, chase, attack, respawn and loot through the assigned immutable Rule definitions.
pipelineStages.result: Damage, death, respawn and collected loot persist as provenance-marked durable results; equipment remains retractable.
pipelineStages.meaning: AuthorityKinematic and presentation profiles select runtime adapters only after the InWorld boundary opens.
pipelineStages.adapter: Unity renews presence, transports input and observations, and rebinds combat presentation without owning combat permission.
pipelineStages.removedPath: Removing a required Rule Block stops future behavior; accepted durable history remains and no SignalR or Unity fallback creates attacks.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: An entered Zone session keeps autonomous scheduling active without requiring SignalR, exact action IDs resolve once, and accepted combat state survives Rule Block migration.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: An expired Zone lease or removed Rule Block stops future scheduling/evaluation; Rule-bound equipment retracts while accepted health, death, respawn and loot history is not rewound.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 입장한 Zone 세션은 SignalR 없이도 자율 스케줄링을 유지하고 정확한 액션 ID가 한 번만 해석되며 승인된 전투 상태는 Rule Block 이관 뒤에도 유지된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: Zone lease가 만료되거나 Rule Block이 제거되면 이후 스케줄링·평가가 멈추고 규칙 종속 장착은 철회되지만 승인된 체력·사망·리스폰·드롭 이력은 되감기지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Character motion uses one controller owner and explicit collision roles
scenarios.titleKo: 캐릭터 이동은 단일 컨트롤러 소유자와 명시적 충돌 역할을 사용한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: LocalCharacterController Physical Meaning grants one motion coordinator the CharacterController.Move lease, maps authored step, slope, skin-width, and minimum-move tuning onto Unity CharacterController settings, and maps ActorBody meaning to its project-owned Unity Physics Layer.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing or changing that Physical Meaning fails closed, restores the original Unity layer, clears step tuning, and removes the local motion lease.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: LocalCharacterController 물리 의미가 하나의 이동 코디네이터에 CharacterController.Move 소유권과 작성된 최대 단차 높이를 제공하고 ActorBody 의미를 프로젝트 소유 Unity Physics Layer에 매핑한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 해당 물리 의미를 제거하거나 변경하면 fail-closed로 원래 Unity Layer를 복원하고 파생 단차 튜닝과 로컬 이동 소유권을 제거한다.

scenarios.title: Unity CharacterController owns collision, slopes, and step resolution
scenarios.titleKo: Unity CharacterController가 충돌·경사·단차 해결을 소유한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Physical Meaning supplies CharacterController tuning while Unity Physics resolves the actual walkable step through the single coordinator-owned Move call; ontology code observes support but never injects a sampled step coordinate.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing LocalCharacterController meaning clears its tuning and movement lease; no retired capsule/raycast/overlap step solver or Transform fallback continues movement.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Physical Meaning은 CharacterController 설정값만 제공하고 실제 보행 단차는 단일 Move 호출에서 Unity Physics가 해결한다. 온톨로지 코드는 지지면을 관측하지만 계산한 단차 좌표를 주입하지 않는다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: LocalCharacterController 의미를 제거하면 설정과 이동 lease가 함께 제거되며 폐기된 캡슐·레이캐스트·오버랩 단차 계산이나 Transform fallback이 동작하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Unity collision contact owns ephemeral grounded state
scenarios.titleKo: Unity 충돌 접촉이 일시적 접지 상태를 소유한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A solid collider permitted by the ontology-derived collision matrix remains grounded when CharacterController reports Below or isGrounded, even when the surface meaning is DynamicProp rather than WalkableSupport.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing the collision permission prevents Unity contact itself; a semantic support probe never fabricates grounded state and never revokes an actual Unity contact.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 온톨로지에서 파생된 충돌 매트릭스가 허용한 단단한 콜라이더는 표면 의미가 WalkableSupport가 아닌 DynamicProp이어도 CharacterController의 Below 또는 isGrounded 접촉이 있으면 접지 상태를 유지한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 충돌 허용 의미를 제거하면 Unity 접촉 자체가 차단되며, 의미 지지면 프로브는 접지를 만들어내지도 실제 Unity 접촉을 취소하지도 않는다.

scenarios.title: Humanoid foot grounding is a Unity presentation result
scenarios.titleKo: 휴머노이드 발 접지는 Unity 표현 결과다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Physical Profile tuning enables Animator IK to align visible feet to Unity Physics contacts without moving the CharacterController or actor root.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing or disabling foot-grounding presentation leaves gameplay collision and grounded state unchanged and no transform fallback moves the actor.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Physical Profile 설정이 Animator IK를 활성화해 CharacterController나 Actor 루트를 움직이지 않고 보이는 발만 Unity Physics 접촉점에 정렬한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 발 접지 표현을 제거하거나 비활성화해도 게임 충돌과 접지 상태는 변하지 않으며 Transform fallback이 Actor를 이동하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Walkable support requires an explicit semantic collision role
scenarios.titleKo: 지지면은 명시적인 의미 충돌 역할이 필요하다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A collider explicitly assigned WalkableSupport can act as character support, while project-owned role-to-layer mappings keep actor bodies, dynamic props, triggers, and water distinct.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: An unauthored static collider is not implicitly walkable, so component shape or Rigidbody absence cannot create hidden support behavior.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: WalkableSupport가 명시적으로 배정된 Collider만 캐릭터 지지면이 될 수 있고 프로젝트 소유 역할-레이어 매핑이 액터 몸체·동적 오브젝트·트리거·물 영역을 구분한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 작성되지 않은 정적 Collider는 자동으로 지지면이 되지 않으므로 컴포넌트 모양이나 Rigidbody 부재가 숨은 지지 동작을 만들 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Walkable slope grounding cannot create a pop or downhill drift
scenarios.titleKo: 보행 가능한 경사 접지는 튕김이나 경사 아래 미끄러짐을 만들지 않는다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Actual grounded contact keeps gravity and adhesion world-vertical, and world-planar locomotion is resolved once by CharacterController on continuous WalkableSupport terrain.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Support proximity cannot inject step rise, and a sampled support normal cannot manufacture either a backward planar component or an upward displacement.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 실제 접지 접촉은 중력과 접지를 세계 수직으로 유지하고 세계 평면 이동은 연속된 WalkableSupport 지형에서 CharacterController가 한 번만 해결한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 지면 근접 감지는 단차 상승을 주입할 수 없고 탐지한 지지면 법선은 역방향 평면 성분이나 위쪽 변위를 만들 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Removing local movement permission does not restore an older durable pose
scenarios.titleKo: 로컬 이동 권한 제거는 이전 영속 위치를 복원하지 않는다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A complete LocalCharacterController meaning enables the single local movement lease while the local avatar retains its runtime presentation pose.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing Physical Meaning disables movement but does not let a stale durable projection reclaim and rewind the visible local Transform.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 완전한 LocalCharacterController 의미는 단일 로컬 이동 lease를 활성화하고 로컬 아바타는 런타임 표시 위치를 유지한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 물리 의미를 제거하면 이동은 비활성화되지만 오래된 영속 투영이 화면상 로컬 Transform을 되찾아 되감지 못한다.

scenarios.title: Authority-approved jump presentation follows one collision-backed phase owner
scenarios.titleKo: Authority가 승인한 점프 표현은 하나의 충돌 기반 단계 소유자를 따른다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: An accepted jump occurrence resolves through manifest entries explicitly owned by MotionStateResolver using current CharacterController observations; attack and equipment entries retain AuthorityIntent ownership, and legacy animation IDs resolve only through declared aliases.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing jump approval or lifecycle-owner metadata removes that route, conflicting owners fail validation, and no intent-name list or generic non-interruptible transient may keep JumpStart selected after physical ascent ends.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 승인된 점프 발생은 Manifest에서 MotionStateResolver 소유자로 명시한 항목과 현재 CharacterController 관찰을 사용해 전환하며 공격·장착 항목은 AuthorityIntent 소유권을 유지하고 이전 애니메이션 ID는 선언된 별칭으로만 해석된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 점프 승인이나 생명 주기 소유자 메타데이터를 제거하면 해당 경로가 사라지고 소유자 충돌은 검증에 실패하며 의도 이름 목록이나 일반 비중단 임시 표현이 실제 상승 종료 뒤에도 JumpStart를 붙잡을 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Animation lifecycle ownership and legacy IDs are manifest metadata
scenarios.titleKo: 애니메이션 생명 주기 소유권과 이전 ID는 Manifest 메타데이터다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A validated definition resolves its declared legacy ID to one canonical animation and routes its intent only to the authored presentation owner.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A duplicate canonical/legacy ID or conflicting owner for one intent fails validation, and no source-name or intent-name normalization restores the removed mapping.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 검증된 정의는 선언한 이전 ID를 하나의 canonical 애니메이션으로 해석하고 의도를 작성된 표현 소유자에게만 전달한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: canonical·이전 ID가 중복되거나 한 의도의 소유자가 충돌하면 검증에 실패하며 원본 이름·의도 이름 정규화가 제거된 매핑을 복구하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Authority owns exact Rule Block identity and contribution lifecycle
scenarios.titleKo: Authority가 정확한 규칙 블록 식별자와 기여 수명주기를 소유
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Quick Setup atomically creates declared Triples and at least one owned published Rule Block for behavior packages, and projection exposes revisioned ownership provenance.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Removing one binding ID retracts only that binding and RuleBound results; the final owned binding closes the package, retracts owned Triples, and preserves independent contributions. A rejected command leaves Unity unchanged.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 빠른 설정은 행동 패키지의 선언 트리플과 게시된 소유 규칙 블록을 원자적으로 만들고 프로젝션은 리비전 기반 소유 출처를 제공한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 바인딩 ID 하나를 삭제하면 해당 바인딩과 RuleBound 결과만 철회하며 마지막 소유 바인딩은 패키지를 닫아 소유 트리플을 철회하되 독립 기여를 보존한다. 거부된 명령은 Unity 상태를 변경하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Authority explicitly transitions one motion writer between HTTP and UDP
scenarios.titleKo: Authority가 HTTP와 UDP 사이의 단일 이동 writer를 명시적으로 전환한다

pipelineStages.trigger: An authenticated client requests an explicit transport promotion or fallback for its active runtime avatar.
pipelineStages.intent: HTTPS carries only exact runtime, transport-session, generation, expected writer epoch, and world revision metadata.
pipelineStages.evaluation: Authority atomically validates ownership scope, runtime session, Zone, revision, redeemed transport binding, writer epoch, and current mode.
pipelineStages.result: The ephemeral writer state advances exactly one epoch and clears the prior intent lease; no world Fact, Rule result, or gameplay permission is created.
pipelineStages.authority: Redis Lua or the equivalent in-memory gate serializes promotion, fallback, generation fencing, and intent admission.
pipelineStages.adapter: Unity sends through only the Authority-acknowledged writer and performs reliable recovery before HTTP resumes.
pipelineStages.removedPath: Without an explicit promotion ACK, UDP intent is rejected; after fallback, stale UDP session, generation, or epoch cannot publish.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: Activation starts HTTP with an Authority-issued epoch, explicit promotion admits only the latest exact connected UDP binding, disconnect revokes only connected presence, and exact fallback atomically fences UDP before a newer HTTP epoch resumes.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Ticket issue, ticket redemption, stale epoch, stale generation, stale session, disconnected or queued packet arrival alone never changes the active writer or creates gameplay state; active UDP rekey requires explicit HTTP fallback.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 활성화는 Authority가 발급한 epoch의 HTTP로 시작하고, 명시적 승격은 정확한 UDP 결합만 허용하며, 명시적 fallback은 더 새 HTTP epoch가 재개되기 전에 UDP를 원자적으로 철회한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 티켓 발급·교환·연결, 오래된 epoch·generation·session 또는 패킷 도착만으로 활성 writer나 게임 상태가 바뀌지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Authority UDP faults cannot bypass canonical admission or writer fencing
scenarios.titleKo: Authority UDP 장애는 canonical 승인과 writer fence를 우회할 수 없다

pipelineStages.trigger: An authenticated UDP datagram arrives, is lost, reordered, replayed, delayed beyond the replay window, or remains queued while the writer falls back to HTTP.
pipelineStages.intent: Only a structurally valid authenticated motion intent with exact transport identity may enter the bounded consumer.
pipelineStages.evaluation: The consumer rechecks connected generation, exact writer scope and epoch, current runtime session, authored locomotion contract, and world revision before registry commit.
pipelineStages.result: At most the newest admissible ephemeral intent is stored; transport loss or failure creates no gameplay or durable result.
pipelineStages.authority: In-memory gates and Redis Lua enforce the same expiry, replay, generation, promotion, submission, and fallback contract across Authority instances.
pipelineStages.adapter: Snapshot paging and backplane fanout remain bounded replaceable presentation transport and never alter Authority state.
pipelineStages.removedPath: After fallback, generation revocation, expiry, replay, or too-old detection, the packet cannot publish even when it was previously authenticated or queued.

scenarios.enabledExpectation: Loss and bounded reorder preserve a monotonic canonical intent sequence, exact current Redis generations pass one batched fence, and the active writer alone may publish.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Replay, too-old input, expired credentials, stale generation, writer mismatch, queued-after-fallback input, snapshot queue overflow, and backplane failure cannot create a durable event, Fact, gameplay result, or second writer.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 손실과 제한 범위 역순 도착에서도 canonical intent sequence는 단조 증가하며 정확한 현재 Redis generation은 일괄 fence를 통과하고 활성 writer만 발행할 수 있다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: replay, too-old 입력, 만료 자격 증명, 오래된 generation, writer 불일치, fallback 후 대기 입력, snapshot 큐 포화, backplane 장애는 영속 이벤트·Fact·게임 결과·두 번째 writer를 만들 수 없다.

scenarios.title: Redis instances share one ticket and motion-writer fault contract
scenarios.titleKo: Redis 인스턴스가 하나의 티켓·이동 writer 장애 계약을 공유한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Two independent Redis clients observe one duplicate-redemption winner, one canonical reissue-or-promotion outcome, and one final writer epoch after concurrent submit and fallback.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Expired or replayed tickets, mismatched batched bindings, stale generations, and stale UDP intent after fallback cannot return key material or commit shared state.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 독립 Redis 클라이언트 두 개가 중복 교환 승자 하나, 재발급 또는 승격의 canonical 결과 하나, 동시 제출과 fallback 뒤 최종 writer epoch 하나를 관측한다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 만료·replay 티켓, 일괄 조회 결합 불일치, 오래된 generation, fallback 뒤 오래된 UDP intent는 키 재료를 반환하거나 공유 상태를 commit할 수 없다.

scenarios.title: UDP reconnect accepts only the fresh transport generation
scenarios.titleKo: UDP 재연결은 최신 transport generation만 허용한다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A disconnected client can reconnect with a fresh Authority binding and publish authenticated motion through the existing canonical sink.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: A bootstrap from the superseded transport session and generation is rejected before it can create peer state or motion input.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 연결이 끊긴 클라이언트는 새 Authority 결합으로 재연결해 기존 canonical sink에 인증된 이동을 제출할 수 있다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 대체된 transport session과 generation의 bootstrap은 peer 상태나 이동 입력을 만들기 전에 거절된다.

scenarios.title: UDP snapshot paging and backplane failure remain replaceable presentation
scenarios.titleKo: UDP 스냅샷 페이지와 backplane 장애는 교체 가능한 표현으로 격리된다
scenarios.enabledExpectation: Authenticated pages remain within MTU, preserve one Authority occurrence, and publish only to exact current Zone peers.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: Queue saturation, stale generation, disconnect, malformed page input, or backplane failure drops only replaceable UDP presentation and never stops Authority or reliable lanes.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: 인증 페이지는 MTU 안에서 하나의 Authority occurrence를 보존하고 정확한 현재 Zone peer에게만 발행된다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 큐 포화, 오래된 generation, 연결 종료, 잘못된 페이지 입력, backplane 장애는 교체 가능한 UDP 표현만 버리며 Authority나 신뢰 경로를 중단하지 않는다.

scenarios.title: Linux x64 Authority container keeps UDP default-off and fail-closed
scenarios.titleKo: Linux x64 Authority 컨테이너는 UDP 기본 비활성과 실패 폐쇄를 유지한다
scenarios.evidenceTest: UdpTransportConfigurationPolicyTests; clean linux-x64 Docker publish; default-off and enabled-without-host-UDP-mapping health smoke
scenarios.enabledExpectation: A non-root Linux Production container with Redis and protected credentials starts healthy with the explicitly enabled UDP listener while HTTPS and SignalR remain available.
scenarios.disabledExpectation: The production image starts with both UDP gates off and no host UDP mapping; incomplete enabled configuration or a privileged listener port fails before serving.
scenarios.enabledExpectationKo: Redis와 보호된 자격 증명을 갖춘 비루트 Linux Production 컨테이너는 UDP 리스너를 명시적으로 켰을 때 healthy가 되고 HTTPS와 SignalR도 계속 사용할 수 있다.
scenarios.disabledExpectationKo: 운영 이미지는 두 UDP gate와 호스트 UDP 매핑이 모두 꺼진 채 시작하며, 불완전한 활성 설정이나 비특권 범위를 벗어난 포트는 서비스 시작 전에 실패한다.
